About

I’m a photographer and political science student in Reims, drawn to the ordinary places where public life actually happens.

I shoot streets, buildings and landscapes without staging them. I also cover events and civic life, from conferences and student organisations to local politics, and take headshots.

  • Based inReims, France
  • StudyingPolitical science
